approved_payload.content: The body of a 44-year-old woman from Keimoes was found in a shallow grave near the river in Currieskamp, Keimoes, at about 13:30 on Sunday 25 October, according to police. Her family had reported her missing on Friday 23 October, and Keimoes police, the Upington Search and Rescue Unit and the Upington K9 Unit searched for her. A 32-year-old man was arrested in Currieskamp on Wednesday 28 October, and police are conducting a murder investigation. An arrest is not a conviction; the woman and the man are not named. When she died is not known: some time between 23 and 25 October. The date shown is when she was found. One source, the SAPS Northern Cape statement of 28 October. The map point is estimated: the grave site is not given, so the pin is in the Currieskamp settlement area.
